verdict.rationale: Only gitlab-docs-14 touches on access control ('Control user access programmatically to maintain consistent permissions across your organization'), but no evidence details workspace/group, project, repository, or branch-level granularity (e.g., protected branches, CODEOWNERS, role-based permissions per project) that GitLab is known for. missing for 10: explicit docs on protected-branch rules, project/group role hierarchies, repository-level permission settings, and independent corroboration of granular access control in practice.
